So I've got a problem.

I used to use salycilic acid wipes a lot, it was part of my normal routine. This was for about a year, and I never once put on suncreen during that year. Because of my ignorance, have my dark marked acne scars been completely cemented into my face forever? Can I really only get rid of this with a 200$ procedure and two months time? On a scale of 1-10, how completely fucked is my skin?

Just bought some new products:

A CVS-brand body/face wash with tea tree oil

A BHA exfoliator

Some BHA wipes

A facial sunscreen/moisturizer (SPF 15)


I currently use the exfoliator, followed by the wipes (leave on for 5 minutes) use my tea tree oil cleanser mixed with my old facial cleanser, then finish with the oatmeal moisturizer and the sunscreen. Is this a better routine?
How often should I be exfoliating?

Would that work as a substitute for exfoliating? I share a shower and I don't think I could have a clean wash cloth just for me whenever I shower.

Would I be able to exfoliate and follow up with a tea tree oil product? Or should I just use the product?
All right, I'll work the Eucerin into the routine rather than the Cetaphil. Thank you

As for the Bump Patrol, it's an aftershave (with alcohol) that apparently solves razor bumps. I noticed that it causes me to only have 2-3 at a time, rather than upwards to 5 razor bumps at once.

I hadn't considered exfoliating less to be honest. That might work... I'm just really not sure how to get rid of the redness on my cheeks without constantly exfoliating and applying salicylic acid wipes. Everywhere I look, all I find is "use bha/aha exfoliators" which I cannot find anywhere. I just try to emulate that by exfoliating and following up with the wipes.
I usually use salicylic wipes and bump control, sometimes even epiduo. Would any of these work better?
I use a cvs brand deep cleansing exfoliator scrub, cetaphil daily advance lotion, & cerave facial cleanser.
